title: Stage-0 atomic batch/device provenance scopes, donor-blocked Student-t / 6 + 6 Welch TOST, and conjunctive imprinting, XCI, MDM4 and mtDNA guardrails
summary: Binds Stage-0 readouts to immutable 4/5/7-key bank, lot and assembled-device scopes, registers non-executable wildcard entry ISLET1_Z_X_MOL_140UM_ZERO_CAO2, adds off-grid Idea Graveyard rules GY-018 and GY-019 for donor-blocked 6 + 6 bank equivalence and epigenetic/clonal/mitochondrial QC, and hardens numerical and routing checks across Layers 1, 3, 4 and 5 with zero change to scores or headline odds.

changes.text: Enforced immutable 4/5/7-key MCBScopeKey, LotScopeKey and AssembledDeviceLotScopeKey envelopes with versioned ENDPOINT_REGISTRY_SPEC in wetlab_contract.py and ingest_wetlab_results.py: blocked cross-lot and cross-device evidence inheritance plus stale prior-batch SE pairing, held all execution_supported = false comparators (including newly registered ISLET1_Z_X_MOL_140UM_ZERO_CAO2 inside the <= 20% Y/Z firewall, ISLET1_B_SCT_* with product-specific locus1_construct, and unmaterialized ISLET1_B2_5LOCUS_BASE), rejected fractional or missing rare-event denominators, enforced observed k == 0 vetoes on Day-28 Gate 0V and sister-unit Day-90 Gate 0S (n >= 2,995,731), computed exact independent recovery bounds U95 = (1 - 0.05**(1/n)) / eta, and latched S9 safety stops until same-scope independent-QP washout reset (DEC-103, IIP-0024, GY-018).

Replaced small-sample asymptotic normal z cut-offs with exact one-sided Student-t (df = n - 1, n >= 6), enforced Donor-1 paired lot blocking (n >= 6) plus >= 2 unrelated ABO O/O seedlines (pi_hat < 0.05) with 6 + 6 unpooled Welch 90% TOST equivalence (97.00% power vs 41.38% at 6 + 3, <= 5.04% boundary size), and registered 23 synchronized Stage-0 endpoints (286 total) for conjunctive 11p15.5 IC1/IC2 + 14q32.2 IG-DMR methylation (MEG3-DMR routed to diagnostic HOLD), female 46,XX XCI (k >= 279 / 300), paired bank-and-Stage-7 1q32.1 MDM4 + 20q11.21 copy number ([1.85, 2.15] + >= 299-cell mosaicism), and >= 1,000x NUMT-filtered mtDNA (< 5% SNV VAF, < 1% deletions, Seahorse reserve >= 1.5x; GY-019).

Hardened shared Layer 1, 3, 4 and 5 engines: strict non-finite and pv > ch validation in the 2^12 common-shock tree plus phi_donor = 0.25 two-seedline sensitivity (50.78% -> 51.53%–51.74% shared A/X, keeping all 2,160 stack scores and 27% / 31% / 36% / 53% headline odds unchanged), product-scoped 5/5 (A, B2, Z) vs 6/6 (B'-SCT) function resolution and 1NW9/1JXQ insertion-code clash audit (565/746 vs 562/746) in Layer 3, exact linear threshold-crossing elapsed TBR < 4.0% (<= 15 min max step) in Layer 4, and explicit-false B'-SCT sub-check precedence plus 3-valued stealth-axis helpers in Layer 5.

title: Stage-0 Design Y wildcard eePASSIGE landing-pad FASTA, TadCBEd vs CRISPRoff reconciliation, ADORA1/ADORA2A physics and Y-01..Y-04 contract
summary: Materializes the 3-comparator Design Y wildcard FASTA inside the <= 20% Y/Z Stage-0 firewall, reconciles eePASSIGE polarity, TadCBEd haplotypes, CIITA isoforms and human ADORA1/ADORA2A diffusion, and adds fail-closed Y-01..Y-04 endpoints with zero change to core blueprints or headline odds.

changes.text: Materialized data/constructs/islet1_design_y_wildcard_comparators_v0.8.0.fasta (SHA-256 c7f54b824a73cf9d40247d4fd251cb5c28a8eca4a1530b9661284200bb4cbabc: 11,066-bp 7-cistron 0x-2A DESIGN_Y_CORE_CD200_IEC, 11,859-bp +CD59, and 12,555-bp CD39 comparators) strictly inside the shared <= 20% Y/Z Stage-0 wildcard firewall with zero changes to Blueprints A, B, or X (DEC-102, IIP-0023).

Upgraded Stage-0 Design Y in Layer 2 and the ranker/playbook: inverted Bxb1 polarity to two-step eePASSIGE 73-bp B2M Exon-1 attP-in-genome + attB-minicircle (separating prospective >= 3.0% hPSC knock-in target from published experimental contexts), reconciled 201-bp CIITA-pIV TSS CGI (Obs/Exp = 0.7982) vs 601-bp (0.5154) and full-length CIITA isoforms (NM_001286402.1 p.Q53*/p.W334* and pIV p.Q29*) alongside TadCBEd C>T + A>G + indel haplotype NGS, and replaced rodent A1/A3 prose with human ADORA1/ADORA2A source-flux reaction-diffusion.

Registered 23 fail-closed Design Y Stage-0 quantitative endpoints (18 core Y-01..Y-04 endpoints plus 5 dedicated >= 60-day age, phased ONT intactness, 4-lineage count, and exact Poisson k = 0 at N_eff >= 299,573,228 AP1903 clonogenic denominators with 1e-12 SE floors), 3 modality enums, and 5 boolean controls that remain NOT_TESTED when Design Y fields are absent.

title: Fail-closed Track-2 NK rescue split, PVR and lineage-necroptosis guardrails, and programmatic 4,096-state portfolio generator
summary: Separates HLA-C B'-SCT (KIR) from held HLA-G1 (LILRB1) NK fallback routing on upper95 subset bounds, adds CC0 RCSB PDB coordinate audits and off-grid Idea Graveyard guardrails for B2M-null CD155/CD226 and lineage-separated necroptosis, and replaces hard-coded 2^12 portfolio decimals with an executable 4,096-state generator.

changes.text: Routed Switch S10/S2 NKG2A- KIR+ (<= 8.0%) and IL-12/IL-18 SIRPa-low (<= 10.0%) NK escape on upper95 confidence bounds when measured (preserving provisional core_14_panel compatibility) and split deprecated track2_b_sct_or_hlag1_lilrb1_rescue_qualified into track2_b_sct_kir_rescue_qualified (n >= 6 KIR-typed donors, 0 failing donors, upper95 <= 8.0%) vs track2_hlag1_lilrb1_rescue_qualified (uniform upper95 <= 8.0% on sorted LILRB1- NKG2A- KIR+ primary NK across n >= 6 donors, held pending HLA-G1 product definition registration with distinct locus2_construct assignment; DEC-101, IIP-0022).

Authenticated CC0-1.0 RCSB PDB coordinate hashes and engineered-crystal disclosures for 3UDW (PVR:TIGIT), 6O3O (PVR:CD226), 6ARQ (PVR:CD96 C110S) and 6AEE (HLA-G1:LILRB1 C42S/L110I/Q115R) in Layer 3 (Ala67 6.41–7.06 Å, C:A 19/23 = 82.61% vs D:B 19/19 = 100% shared contacts), paired with off-grid Idea Graveyard guardrails (preserving 10 grid-firing entries; framing CD155 Ala67Thr rs1058402 across PMIDs 37675979, 35947095, 41202120 and 36170817 as a prospective B2M-/- sign-inversion hypothesis requiring matched-cell testing, and framing SC-beta vs PLVAP+ iEC necroptosis across PMIDs 36707047, 39004142, 25301392, 40796566 and 38981470 with time-resolved viability and orthogonal rescue).

Replaced hard-coded 2^12 portfolio decimals in Layer 1 with an executable 4,096-state (1,024 positive-mass states) common-shock generator computing both legacy 3-slot and shared-A/X 2-route pouch unions across active and prior (DEC-098) hurdle vectors with zero change to published headline odds.

title: Layer-4 two-scale lineage OCR helper, M101 reservoir bound and Stage-0 metabolic-rest and conditioning gates
summary: Prevents sub-unity cell-packing aliasing in Layer 4 via a two-scale lineage-partitioned OCR helper, records parameterized Design Z post-washout/PFC, washout eigenmode, staged exercise lag and closed-slab M101 reservoir bounds, and adds fail-closed Stage-0 120-h OCR and 4-arm Nec-1s × Ferrostatin-1 pellet-LOQ/NQO1 conditioning gates while keeping 791.5 mg CaO2 and 88% Hurdle-1 unchanged.

changes.text: A backward-compatible two-scale lineage-partitioned intrinsic-OCR helper in Layer 4 (scaling whole-slab demand as (m_endo + 0.15 * m_vasc) / 1.15 while passing pure-endocrine m_endo to single-cluster Wigner-Seitz BVPs at explicit areal loading, distinguishing 14.30% vascular cells from 13.04% modeled vascular OCR; PMIDs 23935835, 17130499, 17503968), alongside two-sink and one-sink slab washout eigenmodes, parameterized 48-h washout and 2.5 µm discrete-bead catalase sweeps (>= 73,800 IU retained / ~105,429 IU post-cure), Design Z acute vs chronic vs 5 vol% PFC bounds, conditional staged (v = 0.18, 0.36, 0.60) portal exercise insulin-lag limits (36/60-h vascular timing unchanged, PMID 42547502), and the closed-slab standalone M101 finite-reservoir bound (< 9 s above 15 mmHg, PMIDs 16897713, 37318185; DEC-100, IIP-0021).

Fail-closed Stage-0 120-h assembled-organoid OCR and 4-arm Nec-1s × Ferrostatin-1 pre-encapsulation conditioning gates across 13 endpoints, 3 unpooled metadata keys and 5 boolean locks: barring unencapsulated free-drug washout, requiring simultaneous 0–120 h longitudinal OCR upper95 <= 0.80 with preserved viable lineage function, depot t_1/2 >= 72 h, and post-washout GSIS SI >= 3.0 / >= 85% absolute output / glucagon fold >= 2.0 before any coupled Stage-2 CaO2 reduction test, and gating Vehicle, 10 µM Nec-1s, 2 µM Ferrostatin-1 and combination arms (holding 100 µM benchmark and Nec-1 anti-ferroptotic comparators, PMIDs 41951603, 23190609, 34572979, 29789532, 32893325) on supernatant LC-MS < 10 nM, washed cell-pellet recovery >= 80% and residual <= LOQ, undiluted endocrine and vascular NQO1 activity >= 90% (PMID 34252539), >= 85% SC-beta and PLVAP+ iEC viable yields, and post-washout GSIS SI >= 3.0.

title: Extracellular biomaterial foreign-antigen census, P04040 catalase lock, humoral cuff gates and four-hurdle odds reassessment
summary: Audits extracellular oxygen-pouch and cuff proteins against 20,429 human Swiss-Prot entries, locks Gate P05 to recombinant human catalase (P04040), enforces fail-closed anti-PEG, Day-28 anti-streptavidin, DPR-maleimide hydrolysis and 72-h human hepatocyte gates alongside held streptavidin-free human cuff comparators, and updates the four-hurdle computational estimates.

changes.text: An extracellular biomaterial foreign-peptide census across 20,429 human Swiss-Prot entries in Layer 2 and structural/bioconjugation audit in Layer 3 (PDB 1DGF, 1SWB, 1DX5, 4MSV/3TJE; rejecting 2FHA bacterioferritin), paired with a fail-closed Gate P05 lock requiring recombinant human catalase (UniProt P04040, 0 foreign 8–11-mers in 527-aa and Met-cleaved 526-aa forms, <= 0.10 EU/mg and <= 0.50 EU total-implant endotoxin, <= 30% 7-day shed-protein mass) and disqualifying bovine (P00432) or fungal (P55303) xeno-catalases (DEC-099, IIP-0020).

Donor-stratified Stage-0 humoral, maleimide-stability and hepatocyte safety gates across >= 12 unpooled human sera stratified by baseline anti-PEG IgG/IgM (PMID 27804292) and Day-28 anti-streptavidin IgG (PMIDs 10647616, 29466233, 31782946, 40605797), evaluating retained SA-FasL/SA-THBD alongside a held Mode-B human cuff comparator panel (CFH[19–448] + THBD[363–497]-Cys + H1a ADIPOQ-Hexa-FasL on >= 98% ring-hydrolyzed DPR-maleimide linkers, PMIDs 25194818, 19276268, 21183510, 32619459; <= 5% 14-day bioactive FasL shedding; 72-h primary human hepatocyte caspase-3/7 and ALT/LDH <= 1.2x).

Reassessed the four-hurdle sequential computational estimates (Warning 4 and OQ-016): Design A moves from 26% to 27% (88% x 78% x 57% x 69%), Design B stays at 31% (88% x 79% x 64% x 70%), Design X moves from 34% to 36% (88% x 82% x 73% x 69%), and testing all three side by side moves from 51% (51.48%) to 53% (52.59% locked / 52.22% at fixed c_3 = 0.88 / 55.63% modular; 88% x 87% x 86% x 80%).

title: Four-hurdle computational odds reassessed across all three blueprints
summary: Updates the Blueprint page's four-hurdle computational estimates across Designs A, B and X after IIP-0016 through IIP-0019, puts all three single designs head to head alongside the three-design portfolio figure, and links the hurdle bars to the design switcher.

changes.text: Reassessed the four-hurdle sequential conditional estimates across all three blueprints after IIP-0016–IIP-0019 (Warning 4 and OQ-016): Design A moves from 21% to 26% (88% x 78% x 56% x 68%), Design B to 31% (88% x 79% x 64% x 70%), Design X to 34% (88% x 81% x 70% x 68%), and testing all three side by side moves from 37% to 51% (88% x 87% x 85% x 79%, from an explicit 4,096-state common-shock tree obeying IIP-0003's surviving-design rule).
The summary card on /blueprint#odds now shows Designs X, B and A head to head beside the three-design figure, and the four hurdle cards respond live to the page's Design A, B and X switcher.

Clarified in the odds notes that all four hurdles are computational estimates for each combined design (since layering new untested edits can shift earlier human-anchored steps too) and are reviewed when accepted blueprint changes, human trial data or OpenIslet lab results change our assessment.

title: Layer-4 explicit-3D clumping, microbead-H2O2 barrier and Design-Z micro-optode gates
summary: Adds a Gate-3D-V-verified explicit-3D finite-volume reaction-diffusion audit in Layer 4 quantifying lateral SC-islet clumping, discrete edge-bead peroxide hotspots and 140 µm bead-free pre-vascularized boundary thresholds, and binds Stage-0 Rule S6, Gate P05 and Design Z promotion to fail-closed physical qualification gates.

changes.text: A Gate-3D-V-verified pure-NumPy 3D finite-volume reaction-diffusion audit in Layer 4 (reconciled against both optimistic Dirichlet and coupled Wigner–Seitz spherical closures), quantifying 40.0–60.0% unpatterned 100 µm cluster hypoxia across 160 random-sequential-adsorption clusters at 1,500 IEQ/cm² under 15 µm physical collagen (45 µm hydrogel-equivalent standoff) versus ordered microwells and dose-matched 80 µm spacing at 142.22/152.83 µm pitch (PMID 35241836; DEC-097, IIP-0019).

A discrete-microbead 3D H2O2 plume and cross-section audit (791.5 mg conserved CaO2 inventory) showing uncoated edge-touching beads reach 6.88–19.49 µM and qualifying wet-sieved d_99 <= 50 µm beads paired with >= 20 µm cell-free catalase-immobilized barrier films (~105,429 IU post-cure active load on 333.3 cm² to retain 73,800 IU at >= 70% 7-day retention and hold 24-h burst to 1.13 µM <= 2.5 µM across expanded 390 µm or 350 µm geometries while preserving full 336-h Gate P05; PMID 8720919, PMID 27729543, PMID 36971050).

Fourteen synchronized Stage-0 wet-lab endpoints, three unpooled metadata keys and five persisted boolean flags enforcing dose-matched S6 spacing, Gate P05 barrier-film peroxide/washout clearance, and two-stage Design Z qualification (5-site 14-day empty-lumen micro-optode thresholds plus loaded closed-state pO2, pimonidazole/injury and perifusion GSIS SI >= 3.0 confirmation; PMID 38993891, PMID 25893782, PMID 37476069).

title: Locus-3 Multi-miR(IL1R1+FAS) 6-arm Stage-0 challenger suite and zero-bystander CBE stop comparators
summary: Registers a 6-arm two-strand splice- and seed-hardened Locus-3 intronic Multi-miR(IL1R1 + FAS) Stage-0 challenger FASTA and seven standalone GRCh38 zero-bystander FAS/IL1R1 base-editor stop comparators in Layer 2, reconciles IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP and FasL/DcR3 compartment geometry in Layer 3, and binds promotion to fail-closed Stage-0 RNA, AGO2, GSIS and iCasp9 gates.

changes.text: A 6-arm Mode-B Stage-0 Locus-3 Multi-miR(IL1R1 + FAS) comparator FASTA (4,398-bp donor / 4,688-bp packaged single-AAV6 with 12-bp ITR margin; ARM1 parent, ARM2 scramble, ARM3/ARM4 single-hairpin factorial arms, primary WT-SERPINB9 ARM5 with zero novel peptides and exploratory SERPINB9 C341S ARM6) verified on isolated and chr4-integrated (+/- 300 bp) two-strand splice grammar while keeping canonical Scenario-A FASTAs unchanged (PMID 35880017, PMID 24332856; DEC-096, IIP-0018).

Screened 112 germline type 1 diabetes genetic regions (from OpenTargets top-200 MONDO_0005147 after stripping drug-target, MODY, T2D and exocrine confounders; PMID 34127860, PMID 34012112), ruling out 16 misleading beta-cell knockout traps (16p13 CLEC16A vs DEXI, PTPN2, TNFAIP3, BACH2, CTSH, SOCS1, GLIS3, DLK1, INS, CASP8, FADD, JAK1, STAT1, IFNGR1, IRF1 and TNFRSF1A; PMID 24949970, PMID 30478640, PMID 24608439, PMID 24982147, PMID 21368762) and registering seven live-verified GRCh38 zero-bystander ([4..8]) FAS and IL1R1 cytosine-base-editor stop-needle comparators alongside Layer-3 crystal-interface checks (PDB 4DEP, 3O4O, 4MSV, 4J6G) retiring soluble endothelial IL1R2 decoys (PMID 22426547).

Fail-closed Stage-0 wet-lab contract gates requiring calibrated UMI 5′/3′-RACE (N_UMI_eff >= 3,689, k = 0 aberrant junctions, host ART3 90% TOST [0.80, 1.25]), small-RNA 5′-seed fidelity (>= 85%), AGO2-RIP miR-375 occupancy (>= 90%; PMID 15538371), >= 85% IFN-gamma-induced SERPINB9/PD-L1 retention, >= 70% IL1R1/FAS knockdown, unblunted postprandial IL-1beta perifusion GSIS (PMID 28092375) and >= 99.99% AP1903 iCasp9 kill.

title: Species-separated proteome peptide census, Design B2 TYK2 P1104A HLA-C gate and AlphaMissense v3 provenance
summary: Adds a 22-species human-Swiss-Prot-subtracted peptide census and IEDB T2A/P2A audit in Layer 2, enforces a stratified Stage-0 HLA-C neoantigen OR-hold gate for Design B2 (TYK2 P1104A), and records non-gating CC-BY-4.0 AlphaMissense v3 provenance in Layers 3 and 5.

changes.text: A deterministic human-Swiss-Prot-subtracted sequence-window census across 22 molecular species (659 unique unmatched 8–11-mers across 768 flank contexts), separating mature polypeptides from precursors, readthrough fusions and cryptic-splice tails, comparing canonical P2A against existing 2A-free Locus-3 donors, and recording live-verified IEDB T2A vs untested P2A provenance (PMID 23698740; DEC-095, IIP-0017).

A 32-row MHCflurry v2.3.0 HLA-C/HLA-E presentation ledger for TYK2 p.Pro1104Ala (SAPTKFLEL) annotated with IPD-IMGT/HLA SP-1C/SP-2C/SP-3C leader classes (PMID 37264229, distinct from HLA-B -21M/-21T in PMID 29302013), paired with a fail-closed Stage-0 OR-hold gate across unpooled G/G, G/C and C/C recipient strata on islet and vascular compartments.

Non-gating CC-BY-4.0 AlphaMissense v3 provenance (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10813168, PMID 37733863) across 27 master-cell-bank priority genes and 96 exonic TYK2 missense SNVs alongside unchanged >= 63,000x duplex-sequencing and Tier 6A/6B iCasp9 clonogenic safety gates.

title: HLA-E NKG2A/NKG2C selectivity reconciliation and 20-construct Stage-0 comparator panel
summary: Reconciles soluble HLA-E*01:03 leader-peptide affinities and 13 peptide-bound crystal structures in Layer 3, registers a 20-construct splice-hardened Stage-0 HLA-E comparator panel in Layer 2, and hardens Stage-0 Switch S10 lab release gates.

changes.text: Reconciled all six functional human leader peptides in Lin 2023 (PMID 37264229) on soluble HLA-E*01:03 (0/6 reaching K_C/K_A >= 4.0; VMAPRTLFL acts as a tight NKG2C agonist control), separated from historical HLA-E*01:01 monomer SPR datasets (PMID 10428963, PMID 18448674) and paired with a 13-structure peptide-bound PDB audit excluding unliganded 3BDW (DEC-094, IIP-0016).

A 20-construct Mode-B Stage-0 Locus-1 HLA-E comparator panel (10 arms across Embodiment A* 4,143 bp and Arm 1B 3,974 bp) with two-strand CTC/CTT splice hardening (0 created splice donors or new acceptor coordinates) while keeping all canonical Scenario-A FASTAs unchanged.

Hardened the executable Stage-0 Switch S10 contract (C1–C4): unmeasured extended NK inputs stay marked unmeasured, one-sided 95% confidence bounds govern adaptive NK lysis, calibration controls (VMAPRTLFL, Hsp60 QMRPVSRVL) are hard-blocked from promotion, and challenger advancement requires paired resting and 24-h IFN-gamma sorted NK subset, UL40 CD8+ CTL, regulatory T-cell and 5′/3′-RACE clearance.

title: Two-strand RNA splicing checks and Stage-0 donor comparators
summary: Adds a reproducible two-strand RNA-splicing and DNA-repeat scanner across the inserted donor sequences, registers shielded Stage-0 challenger comparators for Loci 1, 3 and 4, and enforces calibrated RNA recovery and host-gene boundary gates.

changes.text: A reproducible two-strand splice-motif, stop-seam, neo-site and overlapping/disjoint repeat census across all materialised donor templates, plus full-polypeptide reconciliation of the 326 Class-I and 112 Class-II boundary peptide windows (DEC-092, IIP-0015).

Synthesis-ready PAM/seed-shielded and unshielded Stage-0 challenger comparators across Locus 3 (synonymous PD-L1 recoding, bGH 3′-end check and optional single-sided 5′ cHS4 FII), Locus 4 (matched 2×2 orientation × A72T/C73A AAVS1 controls alongside retained SV40 poly(A) 3′-end checks) and Locus 1 (separated 505-aa Embodiment A* and 500-aa Arm 1B/1C stop-seam edits), leaving all canonical reference FASTAs unchanged.

Executable Stage-0 lab contract rules requiring calibrated RNA recovery standards, host-context EndoC-βH1 minigene screening, two-one-sided host-mRNA equivalence bounds with below-quantification holds, and non-pooled clonal UMI junction sequencing alongside intact Tier 6A/6B iCasp9 safety gates.

title: Post-gel immune rechallenge, CD55 complement check and held candidate gates
summary: Adds Stage-0 immune rechallenge tests after gel proteins wear off, an unconfounded ectopic CD55 complement satellite, and strict hold gates for four proposed gene edits.

changes.text: A blocked three-history sibling-aliquot rechallenge after verified loss of SA-FasL and SA-THBD bioactivity, with SA-FHL-1 truth-in-labeling and non-pooled aging-decay vs physical-washout histories (DEC-091, IIP-0012).
An unconfounded same-edited-background +/- ectopic CD55(SCR1-4) attribution satellite preserving endogenous CD59 and IRIS-1/2 insulin exocytosis.

Explicit HOLD_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_FALSIFIER transition gates holding TYMS, Design-B NLRC5, endogenous CD274 +6A>T and single-allele TXNIP ChoRE candidates outside all core constructs without changing Layer-1 scores.

title: Core knock-in safeguards, iCasp9 3D audit and donor TYK2 sweep
summary: Adds Stage-0 neighbouring-gene, splicing and methylation checks around Loci 1, 3 and 4, records the ZnT8 hold, audits three iCasp9 reference crystal structures, and publishes a 10,000-patient donor TYK2 sensitivity sweep.

changes.text: Stage-0 checks for CXCL9, CXCL11 and isoform-resolved ART3 around Locus 3, a four-arm AAVS1 UCOE orientation, splicing and CpG methylation comparison for Locus 4 alongside Arm 1B methylation tracking, and a precautionary hold on donor SLC30A8 knockout (DEC-090, IIP-0011).

Three pinned RCSB crystal structures (1BL4, 1JXQ and 1NW9) in Layer 3 auditing the FKBP12(F36V), Caspase-9 dimer and XIAP-BIR3 interfaces of Locus 4 iCasp9 while keeping full-fusion potency functional tests authoritative.
A 10,000-patient donor TYK2 rs34536443 sensitivity sweep (G/G, G/C and natural C/C) and provenance-only donor IFIH1 rs1990760 tracking in Layer 5.

title: Evidence base expanded to 1,151 studies in the Context–Evidence Graph
summary: Publishes the 1,151-study Type 1 Diabetes Context–Evidence Graph (7,659 groups, 14,105 structured outcomes and 2,447 blueprint links) across the website, downloads and MCP connector while keeping the 563-study scoring baseline explicit.

changes.text: Published the Type 1 Diabetes Context–Evidence Graph (1,151 primary empirical studies, 7,659 experimental and control groups, 14,105 structured outcomes and 2,447 blueprint links, screened from 3,922 candidate records; DEC-089) as an open CC BY 4.0 download and as the new 'evidence' layer in get_layer_atlas.
Documented the explicit separation between the 1,151-study Context–Evidence Graph and the 563-study design-scoring baseline so adding structured literature does not silently shift model scores.

title: Oxygen-release half-life tested across each peroxide recipe
summary: Reclassifies the 68-hour oxygen-release half-life as an unvalidated per-recipe target and publishes an 84-run sensitivity sweep across both peroxide microbead recipes.

changes.text: Labelled the 68.0-hour oxygen-release half-life as a formulation-specific reference target rather than a fixed material constant, and added particle-size placeholders and Stage-0 qualification gates for each CaO2:PDMS recipe (DEC-088, IIP-0010).
An 84-run fixed-inventory sensitivity sweep across half-lives from 24 to 130 hours, three release laws and two blood-vessel connection times for both the 31.25 wt% and 46.39 wt% recipes.
Stopped DOIs with long digit strings from triggering a false phone-number warning in the submission checker.

title: Design X's scored edit and Stage-0 upgrades mapped clearly apart
summary: Marks every Design X mention across the blueprint, tissue simulations and open questions as either the scored insulin-gene edit or the unscored Stage-0 upgrade bundle.

changes.text: Added an explicit mapping in Layer 4, the blueprint and the connector (DEC-087, IIP-0009) distinguishing the scored Design X grid row (119 µm oxygen layer) from the unscored Stage-0 upgrade bundle (100 µm oxygen layer and outer-ring Fas-ligand gel).
Widened open question OQ-015 across Designs A, B and X because all three share the 119 µm baseline oxygen layer in the scored grid.
Stopped negated design names such as '(not Design B)' from adding extra design labels in the submission checker.

title: CD47 study models and density threshold separated accurately
summary: Reclassifies Xu 2024 to its actual non-islet models, removes it from rule GY-009, and separates Hu 2023's primary human islet CD47 threshold from its stem-cell islet counts.

changes.text: Reclassified Xu 2024 (PMID 38508139) from stem-cell islets to four non-islet immune, blood-stem-cell and endothelial models at Tier 2B (DEC-086, IIP-0008), moving Design A's overall score from 0.1085 to 0.1084.

Removed Xu 2024 from Idea Graveyard rule GY-009 and added a separate primary human islet arm to Hu 2023 (PMID 37156915) for the 180,000 to 220,000 CD47 molecules-per-cell transition measured with clone CC2C6 and Quantibrite beads.

title: Open question on combined human immune–islet testing at Stage 1
summary: Adds open question OQ-017 on whether a combined human immune and islet co-culture at Stage 1 can catch cross-talk between immune cell types that split Stage-0 tests miss.

changes.text: Open question OQ-017 and a Stage-1 qualification note beside Readout 3 (DEC-085, IIP-0007), while keeping split Stage-0 Readouts 3A, 3B and 3C separate and mandatory.

title: Testing cell mixes with a bigger share of insulin-making cells
summary: Adds a staged lab comparison of cell mixes between the current 60:30:10 recipe and insulin-cells-only controls, to see whether any lowers tissue volume or oxygen need without weakening protection against low blood sugar.

changes.text: A staged lab comparison in Readout 2 and the HIP-Core protocol (DEC-084, IIP-0006) of four in-between beta:alpha:delta cell recipes (70:20:10, 70:25:5, 80:15:5 and 80:10:10) against the 60:30:10 recipe and the insulin-cells-only controls.

A rule that any candidate recipe must be confirmed in fresh batches, for both insulin shut-off and low-sugar glucagon rescue, before anyone claims a smaller implant dose. The 60:30:10 recipe stays the default unless new measurements justify a change.

title: Testing whether liquid from the cells can calm immune cells
summary: Adds a controlled lab screen to check whether protective PD-L1 protein released by the engineered islet cells into the surrounding liquid is biologically active, not just present.

changes.text: A staged lab test in Readout 3A and Locus 3 (DEC-083, IIP-0005) that checks whether cell-free liquid collected from around the engineered islet cells slows down a separately triggered immune response.
Controls for filter loss and leftover inflammatory signals so a positive or negative lab result cannot be confused with lingering test chemicals or lost particles.

title: Working well after the low-oxygen window
summary: Cells that survive the 14-day low-oxygen window after transplant are now checked for normal insulin and glucagon release before the working dose is counted.

changes.text: A side-by-side lab test of insulin and glucagon release during and after recovery, telling lost cells apart from weakened ones.
A new decision, DEC-082, records the change.

title: The odds now say exactly what they measure
summary: The rough odds on the Blueprint page now define each step, give the reason for each hurdle's three-design figure, and name the checks that sit outside the four hurdles.

changes.text: Each hurdle figure is now a judgement for a design still in the running, given it cleared the earlier hurdles. The 21% and 37% are unchanged.
One reason per hurdle for its three-design figure, in the full blueprint.
A new open question, OQ-016, on how the odds are built and which success they estimate.
Section 3 and Table 3 now say which score they show and which score the rank uses.
The starter pack now includes Table 3, the model scores.

title: Oxygen supply tested under late and weak blood vessels together
summary: Blood vessels that connect late and vessels that carry less oxygen than hoped are now tested together, and the whole grid is published.

changes.text: A joint test of when the blood vessels connect (36 to 60 hours in 4-hour steps, plus 96 and 168 hours as stress tests) and how well they carry oxygen, under both of the model's oxygen-release laws, with unrounded results and a finer-mesh check of the closest calls.
An exact no-blood-vessel lower bound: what the cells get with no vessels at all.
A table of where each setting in the test comes from.
The timing axis is now labelled as the target midpoint; the realised half-way point comes about 3 hours later.
The Python requirement is now numpy 2.0 or later, which the Layer 4 code needs (it crashed on older versions).
